name: Spacebring
description: Connect your Spacebring co-working space so the assistant can book, move and cancel rooms for members, invite their guests, report issues to the team and answer house questions.

spacebring_get_member.label: Get Member
spacebring_get_member.description: Look up a member by email: plan, credits, upcoming bookings, guest visits and open tickets.

spacebring_find_available_spaces.label: Find Available Spaces
spacebring_find_available_spaces.description: See which rooms, desks or other spaces are free for a time slot.

spacebring_book_space.label: Book a Space
spacebring_book_space.description: Book a room or desk for a member after checking the slot is free.

spacebring_move_booking.label: Move Booking
spacebring_move_booking.description: Move a member's booking to another time or space, booking the new slot before freeing the old one.

spacebring_cancel_booking.label: Cancel Booking
spacebring_cancel_booking.description: Cancel one of the member's own bookings.

spacebring_invite_guest.label: Invite Guest
spacebring_invite_guest.description: Register a guest visit; Spacebring emails the guest their invite.

spacebring_cancel_guest_visit.label: Cancel Guest Visit
spacebring_cancel_guest_visit.description: Cancel a guest visit the member registered.

spacebring_report_issue.label: Report Issue
spacebring_report_issue.description: Report a problem in the space (Wi-Fi, AC, access, cleaning, repairs) to the team.

spacebring_search_guides.label: Search House Guides
spacebring_search_guides.description: Answer house questions (Wi-Fi, opening hours, rules) from the space's guides.

spacebring_whats_on.label: What's On
spacebring_whats_on.description: Upcoming community events and the latest announcements.

spacebring_list_perks.label: List Perks
spacebring_list_perks.description: Member perks and partner discounts, with how to redeem them.

spacebring_list_plans.label: List Plans
spacebring_list_plans.description: Membership plans on offer, with prices.

apiKeyId.label: API Key ID
apiKeyId.description: Spacebring API key ID (the username for Basic auth). Generate API credentials in Spacebring under Settings → Integrations → API.

apiKeySecret.label: API Key Secret
apiKeySecret.description: Spacebring API key secret (the password for Basic auth). Stored encrypted.

locationRef.label: Default Location
locationRef.description: Name or ID of the location this assistant serves. Leave empty if your network has a single location; with several, members are asked which one.

timeZone.label: Time Zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone (e.g. Europe/Lisbon) used when Spacebring does not report one for the location. Members' times are read and shown in it.
